title: Check selected state
summary: A checkbox has a selected state that can be inspected. Clicking toggles that state.
introduction: A checkbox has a selected state that can be inspected. Clicking toggles that state. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: A checkbox has a selected state that can be inspected. Clicking toggles that state.

blocks.code:
from urllib.parse import quote
from selenium import webdriver
from selenium.webdriver.common.by import By

driver = webdriver.Chrome()
try:
    driver.get("data:text/html;charset=utf-8," + quote('<label><input id="remember" type="checkbox">Remember</label>'))
    box = driver.find_element(By.ID, "remember")
    box.click()
    assert box.is_selected()
finally:
    driver.quit()
blocks.title: Check selected state

blocks.text: The checkbox is selected after the click.
